newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Tenet Healthcare Q4 oper shr rises.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Tenet Healthcare Q4 oper shr rises.

text.p: Merger, facility consolidation and other non-recurring charges (1.04) (0.18) (1.66) (0.18)

NOTE: Including all unusual or non-recurring items related to continuing operations, Tenet had a net loss from continuing operations for the 1997 fourth quarter of $205.5 million, or $0.67 cents per share, compared with income from continuing operations of $55.8 million, or $0.19 cents per share, in the 1996 fourth quarter.

Including the loss from discontinued operations and the extraordinary charge, Tenet recorded a net loss of $339.5 million, or $1.10 per share, in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997, compared with net income of $7.6, or $0.03 cents per share, in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.

For the full year, including all unusual or non-recurring items related to continuing operations, Tenet recorded a loss from continuing operations of $72.6 million or $0.24 cents per share, compared with income from continuing operations of $498.2 million, or $1.70 per share, in fiscal 1996.

Including the loss from discontinued operations and the extraordinary charge, for the full year Tenet had a net loss of $254.0 million, or $0.84 cents per share, compared with net income of $450,200,000, or $1.54 per share, in fiscal 1996.
